weather_report:
The morning light casts a muted glow over the city of Boston, blanketed under a quilt of shifting clouds that hint at a day of varied hues. As the temperature hovers comfortably around the lower sixties, the northeast winds weave through the cityscape, bringing with them a briskness that may invite a light jacket or sweater. Residents can expect a blend of sun and clouds as the day unfolds, with the invitation of gentle breezes rustling leaves, creating an ambiance conducive to leisurely strolls along the waterfront or a casual coffee under an awning.

As evening approaches, the clouds will shift to a more muted canvas, offering a tranquil backdrop for a relaxed evening outdoors. With temperatures dipping only slightly, the opportunities for outdoor dining or perhaps a quiet moment at a favorite park remain enticing. With the chance of some lingering clouds, it may be wise to keep an eye on the horizon while you consider tonight’s plans. Whether meandering through an art exhibit or simply taking in the serene dusk over the Charles River, the softness of the day promises moments of simple joys.
